facts.fact: Biometric Update, reporting a Vital Strategies case study, says Rwanda's civil registration moved from one where families travelled long distances to register births and deaths to a decentralised and digitalised system; no date is given for the state described, so the document's publication date is used.
Biometric Update, reporting a Vital Strategies case study, says the digitalised system has thousands of registration points, giving no count, total or year; the document's publication date is used.

systems.owner: Government of Rwanda; Vital Strategies has supported its modernisation since 2016
systems.tiers: decentralised, thousands of registration points; connects with hospitals, government agencies and businesses

systems.system: integration of birth registration with the national ID system
systems.tiers: real-time identity verification and data sharing across sectors; supports access to around 200 services
